text:
alex: quick follow-up on the sideloaded/offline update RFC — trying to nail down verifier/operator UX and a minimal rollback contract. linking the draft: https://r.redwood/sideload-rfc :wave

maria: thanks — my main q is around signer rotation during an offline rollout. how does the verifier handle stale escrow keys? do we require a full re-sign of bundles? :thinking:

alex: good point. sketching two modes: 1) forward-only: bundles signed by a rotating CA, operator trusts CA fingerprint pinned at install. 2) escrowed-rotation: operator holds encrypted escrow to re-verify, requires an operator-level rekey step. prefer forward-only for simplicity.

sam: can we handle both via manifest metadata? include "signing_chain": "ca-v3" and a small handshake field `operator_asserts: true` so operator can opt-in. example manifest snippet: ```{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "signing_chain": "ca-v3",
  "manifest_id": "sha256:abc123...",
  "operator_asserts": false
}```

anika: operator_asserts=false by default sounds safe. but what about emergency rollback if operator loses keys? need a recovery path that doesn't require airgapped access to HQ.

alex: idea: include a dual-anchor fallback — primary CA + an emergency threshold-signer (n-of-m). emergency anchor is only accepted when operator flips an annotation on the local controller (requires physical admin and audit log). keeps airgap safety but enables local recovery.

maria: admin UX question — how do we present that flip in Console? we should surface: 1) current anchors, 2) a dry-run validation mode, 3) an explicit emergency toggle with mandatory comment. similar to k8s eviction UI.

sam: implement dry-run as `--validate-only` on the sideload CLI and a reconciliation annotation `sideload.redwood/validated-manifest: <id>`. ops can preview without applying.

dev-bot: sideload-ci: manifest linter passed (sha256:abc123) — no schema errors. :white_check_mark:

anika: storage/retention: manifests and blobs should be GC'd after N days unless marked pinned. propose default 30d for manifests, 90d for blobs. keep a fast-path cache for last-applied manifest for rollback.

ops-bot: note: auditors will want immutable audit trail. suggest we append signed-apply events to local audit.log and expose a compact proof (merkle root) for offsite verification.

alex: agree. action items: 
- sam: draft manifest field additions + CLI flags for validate-only and emergency-flip
- maria: mock up console emergency toggle + audit prompt copy
- anika: document retention defaults and GC opt-outs
- ops-bot/dev-bot: prototype audit-log merkle root export (P0)

maria: also, add an explicit compatibility matrix field `min_operator_version` so old controllers won't try to apply unsupported manifests. avoids silent failures.

sam: will add `min_operator_version` and a `compatibility_notes` free text field.

alex: nice. if nobody objects i'll update the RFC with these tradeoffs and a short appendix on replay/recovery. low-churn for now, we can iterate on emergency UX after a pilot. :+1:

anika: +1 from infra ops

maria: +1 from product

sam: +1 — i'll open the PR today

alex: thanks all — closing thread, will link PR once ready.
